stem: In the figure, line \(\ell\) is parallel to line \(m\). Point \(A\) lies on line \(\ell\), and point \(B\) lies on line \(m\). What is the value of \(x\)?
solution: Draw lines through \(P\) and \(Q\) parallel to \(\ell\) and \(m\). Each of these lines splits the angle at that point into two parts.
At \(Q\): the lower part is an alternate interior angle with the \(30^{\circ}\) angle at \(B\), so it is 30°, and the upper part is \(75 - 30 = 45^{\circ}\).
At \(P\): the lower part is an alternate interior angle with that \(45^{\circ}\) part, and the upper part is an alternate interior angle with the \(25^{\circ}\) angle at \(A\).
verify:
P=figure['points']
d=lambda a,b: sqrt((P[a][0]-P[b][0])**2+(P[a][1]-P[b][1])**2)
ang=lambda a,v,b: N(acos(((P[a][0]-P[v][0])*(P[b][0]-P[v][0])+(P[a][1]-P[v][1])*(P[b][1]-P[v][1]))/(d(a,v)*d(b,v)))*180/pi)
assert P['C'][1]==P['D'][1]==P['A'][1] and P['E'][1]==P['F'][1]==P['B'][1]
assert abs(ang('D','A','P')-25)<0.1 and abs(ang('P','Q','B')-75)<0.1 and abs(ang('E','B','Q')-30)<0.1
ans=25+75-30
assert abs(ang('A','P','Q')-ans)<0.1
assert Rational(spr_answers[0])==ans==70
